verses.text: So, here’s how the good news about Jesus the Messiah, God’s Son, kicked off. 🌟
Just like the prophets wrote: “Look, I’m sending my messenger ahead of you; he’ll get your road ready.
“He’s that voice calling out in the wilderness: ‘Get the Lord’s road ready! Make his paths straight!’”
John showed up in the wilderness, baptizing people and calling them to turn back to God so their sins could be forgiven.
People rolled in from all over Judea and Jerusalem. They confessed their sins, and John baptized them in the Jordan River. 🌊
John wore camel-hair clothes with a leather belt and ate locusts and wild honey. That was his whole look.
He kept preaching: “Someone way stronger than me is coming after me. I’m not even worthy to bend down and untie his sandals.
“I baptize you with water, but he’ll baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
Around then, Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan.
As Jesus came up out of the water, he saw the sky split open and the Spirit coming down on him like a dove.
A voice came from heaven: “You are my beloved Son. I’m so pleased with you.”
Right away, the Spirit sent Jesus out into the wilderness.
He was there forty days, with Satan testing him. He stayed among wild animals, and angels looked after him.
After John was arrested, Jesus went to Galilee, announcing God’s good news:
“The time is here! God’s Kingdom is close. Turn back to God and trust the good news.” 📣
As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he spotted Simon and his brother Andrew throwing a net into the water. Fishing was their job.
“Come follow me,” Jesus told them, “and I’ll teach you to fish for people.”
Immediately, they dropped their nets and followed him.
A little farther along, Jesus saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, fixing their nets.
He called them too. They left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired workers and went with Jesus.
They arrived in Capernaum. On the Sabbath, Jesus went into the synagogue and started teaching.
The people were amazed. He taught with real authority, nothing like their legal experts.
Right then, a man with an unclean spirit was in the synagogue. He shouted:
“Yo! What do you want with us, Jesus from Nazareth? Did you come to wipe us out? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”
Jesus ordered the spirit, “Quiet! Come out of him!”
The spirit threw the man into a fit, screamed loudly, and came out of him.
Everyone was stunned. They asked each other, “What is this? A new teaching—with real authority! He even orders unclean spirits around, and they listen!”
News about Jesus spread fast across the whole Galilee region.
As soon as they left the synagogue, Jesus went with James and John to Simon and Andrew’s house.
Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever. They told Jesus about her straight away.
He went to her, took her hand, and helped her up. The fever left, and she started serving them.
That evening, after sunset, people brought Jesus everybody who was sick or oppressed by demons.
The whole town gathered outside the door. The place was packed.
Jesus healed many people with all kinds of illnesses and drove out many demons. He wouldn’t let the demons speak, because they knew who he was.
Very early, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went somewhere quiet to pray. 🙏
Simon and the others went looking for him.
When they found him, they said, “Everybody’s looking for you!”
Jesus replied, “Let’s head to the nearby towns so I can preach there too. That’s why I came.”
So he traveled all through Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
A man with a serious skin disease came to Jesus. He knelt and begged him, “If you’re willing, you can make me clean.”
Jesus was moved with compassion. He reached out, touched him, and said, “I am willing. Be clean.”
At once the disease left him, and he was clean. Just like that.
Jesus gave him a firm warning and sent him away straight away.
“Don’t tell anyone,” he said. “Go show yourself to the priest and bring the offering Moses commanded for your cleansing. That’ll be your public proof.”
But the man went out and told everybody, spreading the news everywhere. After that, Jesus couldn’t openly enter a town. He stayed out in quiet places, but people kept coming to him from everywhere.
